title: All About Nell
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, first long vowels ai, ee, igh, 38-sound stage.

pages.brief: Close view of Nell, a bee with yellow and black stripes, perched on a sunflower.
Nell the bee hovering just above the sunflower, wings a blur.
Close view of Nell the bee's big round eyes, looking out over a garden wall.
Nell the bee flying high up above the garden wall, small against a bright blue sky.
Nell the bee resting on top of the warm garden wall in bright sunshine.
Nell the bee sheltering on the wall as raindrops fall around her, looking damp and unhappy.
Nell the bee tucked still against the wall, raindrops still falling but starting to ease.
Nell the bee flying happily above the wall again in bright sunshine, rain gone.
